subject: maths
source: NCERT Ganita Prakash | Grade 6, Chapter 5 + BHPS midterm model paper (2026-27)

questions.q: In the idli-vada game (idli: multiples of 3, vada: multiples of 5), what is the first number for which children say ‘idli-vada’?
questions.e: 15 is the first common multiple of 3 and 5.

questions.q: Numbers that are multiples of both 3 and 5 are called…
questions.e: 15, 30, 45, … are common multiples.

questions.q: What are the common factors of 20 and 28?
questions.e: Factors of 20: 1, 2, 4, 5, 10, 20. Factors of 28: 1, 2, 4, 7, 14, 28. (Model paper Q23.)

questions.q: A number whose factors (other than itself) add up to the number is called a perfect number. Which is a perfect number?
If the idli-vada game is played from 1 to 90, how many times is ‘idli-vada’ said?
questions.e: Common multiples of 3 and 5 up to 90: 15, 30, 45, 60, 75, 90 → 6.

questions.q: Numbers that have exactly two factors are called…
questions.e: The two factors are 1 and the number itself.

questions.q: The number 1 is…
questions.e: 1 has only one factor.

questions.q: The only even prime number is…
questions.e: Every other even number has 2 as a factor.

questions.q: The smallest composite number is…
questions.e: 4 has factors 1, 2, 4.

questions.q: Which pair are twin primes?
questions.e: Twin primes are primes that differ by 2.

questions.q: The Sieve of Eratosthenes is a method to…
questions.e: Cross out multiples of each prime; the circled numbers left are primes.

questions.q: Which are seven consecutive composite numbers between 1 and 100?
questions.e: 90, 91 (7×13), 92, 93 (3×31), 94, 95, 96 are all composite; 89 and 97 are prime.

questions.q: Which statement is true?
questions.a: There is no prime number whose units digit is 4
w: A product of two primes can be prime
questions.e: Any number ending in 4 is even and bigger than 2, so it is composite.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): 2 is a prime number.
Reason (R): All prime numbers are odd.
questions.a: A is true, but R is false.
w: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is false, but R is true.
questions.e: A is true, but R is false because 2 itself is an even prime.

questions.q: Two numbers are co-prime if…
questions.e: Example: 4 and 9 are co-prime. (Model paper Q11.)

questions.q: Are 15 and 39 co-prime?
Are two different prime numbers always co-prime?
w: Only if they are twin primes
questions.e: Each prime's only factors are 1 and itself, so the only common factor is 1.

questions.q: Are two consecutive numbers (like 14 and 15) always co-prime?
questions.e: Any common factor would also have to divide their difference, 1.

questions.q: Are 22 and 44 co-prime?
Writing a number as a product of prime numbers is called…
What is the prime factorisation of 456?
Which number has no prime factorisation?
questions.e: 1 is not divisible by any prime.

questions.q: What is the smallest number whose prime factorisation has three different prime numbers?
The prime factorisation of a number is unique. This means…
questions.a: every number has only one set of prime factors (order doesn't matter)
w: the factors must be written biggest first
a number can have many different sets of prime factors
questions.e: 36 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 however you start.

questions.q: A number is divisible by 10 if…
questions.e: Multiples of 10 end in 0.

questions.q: A number is divisible by 5 if…
questions.e: Multiples of 5 end in 0 or 5.

questions.q: A number is divisible by 4 if…
questions.a: the number formed by its last two digits is divisible by 4
w: its digit sum is divisible by 4
questions.e: Only the last two digits matter. (Model paper Q37b: 3366 → 66 is not divisible by 4.)

questions.q: A number is divisible by 8 if…
questions.a: the number formed by its last three digits is divisible by 8
w: its last two digits are divisible by 8
questions.e: Only the last three digits matter. (Model paper Q21.)

questions.q:
Assertion (A): 546840 is divisible by 8.
Reason (R): 840 is divisible by 8.
questions.a: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
w: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.
questions.e: 840 ÷ 8 = 105, and the last three digits decide divisibility by 8. R explains A. (Model paper Q21 style.)

questions.q:
Assertion (A): 3366 is divisible by 4.
Reason (R): 3366 is an even number.
questions.a: A is false, but R is true.
w: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
questions.e: A is false: 66 is not divisible by 4. R is true but being even is not enough for 4.
